tinder.note: the template - squeezed 158->190+ earlier this year; still #1 SI on the board

tinder_trigger: day change >= +8% AND relative_volume_10d_calc >= 3, OR day change >= +15% alone
blast_trigger: market-wide catch-all for squeezes NOT on the list: change >= 18% AND rvol >= 4 AND close > $3 AND mcap > $500M AND exchange in NYSE/NASDAQ/AMEX (no OTC)
push_format: SQUEEZE WATCH: <sym> +X% RVOL Y, SI Z% float - CAR-style ignition. LOOK only: spec-tier $300 rules, no chase, verify news + borrow. (blast hits: 'SI unknown - verify')

options_playbook.why: Omar 2026-08-05: CAR ran ~700% - the options expression of a squeeze is exponentially bigger. Convexity is real AND max loss = premium (solves the gap-risk problem stops can't). But squeeze-name IV is brutally expensive and most tinder names never ignite - so calls are bought ON IGNITION (watcher fire + RVOL confirmed), NEVER pre-positioned waiting.
options_playbook.structure: OTM calls, ~15-25 delta, 30-45 DTE - the OPPOSITE of the GE/UAL deep-ITM lesson, because here the thesis IS the tail: max convexity per dollar, premium is the stop. Chain gate first: OI >= ~500 on the strike, spread <= ~10% of mid (AMG-style dead chains = auto-skip).
options_playbook.sizing: spec-tier per protocol: $300 half-unit per name (NOT the $2.5k overlay budget), max 2-3 squeeze tickets concurrent. A $300 ticket on a CAR-style run = potentially 10-50x; 10 straight duds = -$3k, survivable by design.
options_playbook.exits_preregistered: squeezes retrace violently: sell 1/2 at +100%, 1/4 at +300%, let the rest ride on house money with a close-below-prior-day-low kill; hard time exit 21 DTE; NO averaging down ever.
options_playbook.validation: PAPER-FIRST per the 7/29 standing order + rule freeze: every watcher fire gets an auto paper ticket in research/options-paper-ledger.json graded on the weekly scorecard; real $300 tickets only on Omar's per-signal go until the paper cohort proves the playbook (~10+ graded signals).
